mechanism: Tretinoin increases photosensitivity and skin irritation risk, while fluphenazine also causes photosensitivity; combined use increases risk of severe dermatologic reactions and potential CNS effects from additive photosensitive mechanisms.
action: Counsel patients on strict sun protection (SPF 30+, protective clothing) and monitor for excessive photosensitivity reactions; consider alternative antipsychotic if severe skin reactions develop.
